purpose: Treat an event as the opportunity for a new development.
keywords: N + を機に / を機として
I started cooking for myself when I moved.
I returned to my hometown upon retirement.
Winning the award led to the work becoming widely known.
formation: N + を機に / を機として
restrictions: Often marks a deliberate change following a milestone.
mistake: The event is a trigger or opportunity, not necessarily the sole cause.
